units.title: news/advice/information + scissors/trousers
units.shortDescription: Существительные-обманки: единственные на вид, множественные на деле.
units.theoryHtml:
Три группы существительных-ловушек:

ГруппаСловаГлагол
Неисчисляемые, похожи на мн.ч.news, physics, economics, mathematicsед.ч.: The news is good.
Неисчисляемые всегдаadvice, information, furniture, luggage, equipment, progress, homeworkед.ч., без a/an: some advice
Всегда множественныеscissors, trousers, jeans, glasses, stairs, clothes, thanks, police, peopleмн.ч.: The scissors are sharp.

Как посчитать: a piece of advice/news, an item of furniture, a pair of scissors/trousers, two pairs of jeans. police и people всегда мн.ч.: The police are coming.

⚠ Частые ошибки: an advice → a piece of advice. informations → information. The police is coming → are coming. a people → people (или a nation).

Мини-диалог:
— Did you bring the scissors? — Yes, and a pair of trousers for the climb.
— Any news from the guide? — The news is good — we leave at dawn. He gave me one more piece of advice: sleep now.

exercises.prompt: How much ___ is there in the flat?

exercises.explanation: a pair of jeans → two pairs.

units.title: Would you mind...? — вежливые формы
units.shortDescription: Would you mind + -ing — самая вежливая просьба.
units.theoryHtml:
Лестница вежливости от приказа к деликатной просьбе:

ФормаСилаПример
Open the window.приказ/инструкцияOpen the window, please.
Can you...?нейтральноCan you open the window?
Could you...?вежливоCould you open the window?
Would you mind + -ing?очень вежливоWould you mind opening the window?
I was wondering if you could...максимально деликатноI was wondering if you could help me.

Ответ на Would you mind...? ловушка: No, not at all = «конечно, помогу» (не против!), а Yes = «против».

Ещё вежливые конструкции: Could I possibly...?, Would it be possible to...?, I'd appreciate it if you could...

⚠ Частые ошибки: Would you mind to open → mind opening. Yes, of course в ответ на mind — путает собеседника (выходит «да, я против»).

Мини-диалог:
— Would you mind closing the window? — Not at all.
— And would it be possible to move my seat? — I'll see what I can do.

exercises.prompt: Would you mind if I ___ the TV?
exercises.explanation: Would you mind if I + Past (вежливо).

exercises.prompt: Вежливый ответ на «Would you mind helping me?»:
I was wondering if you ___ give me a lift.
exercises.explanation: I was wondering if you could...

exercises.prompt: Расставь по вежливости (самая вежливая последней): 1. Can you...? 2. Open it. 3. Would you mind...?
exercises.explanation: Open it → Can you → Would you mind.

exercises.prompt: Would it be possible ___ a late checkout?
I'd ___ ___ (был бы признателен), if you could reply today. (appreciate)

units.title: hard/hardly, late/lately, near/nearly
units.shortDescription: Наречия-обманки: добавь -ly и смысл изменится полностью.
units.theoryHtml:
Пары, где форма с -ly означает ДРУГОЕ:

ПараБез -lyС -ly
hard / hardlyhard = усердно: work hardhardly = едва ли: I hardly know him.
late / latelylate = поздно: arrive latelately = недавно: Have you seen him lately?
near / nearlynear = близко: live nearnearly = почти: nearly finished
high / highlyhigh = высоко: fly highhighly = очень (оценка): highly recommend
free / freelyfree = бесплатноfreely = свободно
most / mostlymost = больше всегоmostly = в основном

⚠ Частые ошибки: I hardly work в значении «работаю усердно» — на самом деле «почти не работаю»! It's late recently → lately. I nearly agree → I almost agree или I fully agree (nearly agree звучит странно).

Мини-диалог:
— Do you see Mark lately? — Hmm, we hardly ever meet. He works hard and travels most of the time.
— Nearly everyone says that about him.

exercises.prompt: I ___ know anyone at this party.
Have you seen any good films ___?
Try ___ (изо всех сил)! (do your best → work ___)
